info.title: Agent Platform Agent API (internal)
info.description: Internal API called only by the gateway (README §6.2).

200.description: Server-sent events; each `data` is an AgentEvent (docs/events.schema.json).

409.description: turn_in_flight: another turn holds the conversation

503.description: service_busy: every turn lock connection is in use

post.description:
Withdraws a persisted reply from the history (ADR-0048). Called by the gateway
when a finished turn's audit record cannot be written.

204.description: The reply is marked retracted; Context Assembly no longer includes it.

409.description: turn_in_flight: a turn kept the conversation locked

503.description: service_busy: every turn lock connection is in use

get.description:
The caller's own memory items and memory switch (README §8). No endpoint reads
another user's memory.

404.description: memory_not_found, also for another user's item

put.description:
Turns the caller's memory on or off. Off, nothing is written or retrieved for
them; stored items stay until they delete them.

get.description:
What every model call of a turn saw (README §7). Off unless DEBUG_CONTEXT_ENABLED.
It reaches a conversation outside a turn, so it does not go through the turn
runner's binding and checks ownership itself: only the conversation's owner
reads it (ADR-0059).

post.description: Version 1 of a new id; 409 policy_exists when the id is taken.

get.description: Every policy's current version and switch as one importable YAML document.

post.description:
All or nothing: an absent id is created, a changed one versioned, a switch alone
switched, an identical one left alone.
What this draft would override if saved now (ADR-0105): the edit form shows it.
The body becomes the next version and the current one; versions are immutable (I2).

put.description: Switches the policy on or off; no new version.

get.description:
The policy's change log (ADR-0108): every create, version, switch, import and seed,
with its actor and the exception flag it left.

details.title: Details
details.description: What is wrong, e.g. a policy's validation errors.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: Every model call of the turn, in assembly order.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether memory is written and retrieved for this user.

PolicyChangeView.title: PolicyChangeView
PolicyChangeView.description: One change of a policy, written by the agent in the change's transaction (ADR-0108).

PolicyDocument.title: PolicyDocument
PolicyDocument.description:
A policy as the admin API reads and writes it (README §10.1). On create and on a new
version, `version` is ignored: the store assigns it (I2).

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Matched evaluations of real turns per UTC day, policy and action.

PolicyOverrides.title: PolicyOverrides
PolicyOverrides.description: What a draft would override if saved now, and whether that makes it an exception.

principal.description: Whom to evaluate for; default: the admin, with no policy roles.

target.title: Target
target.description: DATA only; default: the first target, else answer.

PolicyTestRequest.title: PolicyTestRequest
PolicyTestRequest.description:
Evaluates one policy, stored (`policy_id`, its current version, on or off) or a draft
(`policy`), against sample text on the runtime engine path; nothing is recorded.

action.title: Action
action.description: What the engine decided for this text.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: The checker's explanation in English, as traces record it.

explanation_key.title: Explanation Key
explanation_key.description: The explanation as a key under the web's policies.explanation.* (rule 7).

explanation_args.title: Explanation Args
explanation_args.description: Arguments of explanation_key; `items` lists names separated by newlines.

spans.title: Spans
spans.description: Matched regions of `text`, by character offsets.

output_text.title: Output Text
output_text.description: The text after redaction, for text checkpoints.

error.title: Error
error.description: The checker's error, when it failed (see on_error).

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: What this version overrode when it was saved.

exception.title: Exception
exception.description: Whether it was an exception when it was saved.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the policy's head (current version, switch) last changed.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: id@version of the wider policies of its group it overrides among the current versions, recomputed for the whole group on every change (ADR-0108).

exception.title: Exception
exception.description: It overrides a stricter policy of its group (ADR-0105, ADR-0108).

package.title: Package
package.description: The ContextPackage a model call received, with its accounting.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Error code that withdrew the reply.

SimulatedPrincipal.title: SimulatedPrincipal
SimulatedPrincipal.description: A principal for the test panel: which tenant and policy roles to evaluate the policy for.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: UUID, lower-case; the gateway normalises it (ADR-0050).
